title: ShipperInvoiceIssued
description: The ERP issued a Shipper invoice over a Shipper's Waiting Billable lines (Canonical Model event, version 1). Published on the Invoicing events topic through the ERP's transactional outbox, in the transaction that issued the invoice, under a new correlation ID created for the invoice. It carries the whole invoice with its lines, totals and Shipper, so its consumers need nothing more.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID the ERP created for the invoice; the same as the invoice's.
